key_points: Rograkh as 0-mana color/free-spell enabler (Mox Amber, Deflecting Swat, Fierce Guardianship, Flare of Duplication free with commander in play)
Ishai often color provider (white/blue), occasionally early threat growing through opponent spells
Midrange-control loving the long game; engine-spam, then a single finish: Underworld Breach
transfer_limitations: cEDH only; Breach/LED finish and engine-spam NOT transferable to the high_power/casual target deck; shared cards limited to Springleaf Drum and Flare of Duplication
